QuestInfo.name: Who is Spiegelmann?!
QuestInfo.0: While going through the Monster Park, you've found another Old Picture of Spiegelmann in an Old Envelope. Go ask Spiegelmann about it.
QuestInfo.1: While going through the Monster Park, you've found another Old Picture of Spiegelmann in an Old Envelope. Go ask Spiegelmann about it.
QuestInfo.2: Spiegelmann avoided talking about the picture. He's clearly trying to hide something. Who could Spiegelmann be?

0.0: You simply cannot stay away, can you? Heh heh. Now, what is it?\r\n#L0##bThere was a picture of you in this #b#t2430290# I found in Monster Park#k. It shows you creating Zakum. Now, I want some answers...#l\n#k
0.1: A picture? So many strange pictures floating around these days. Look, I'm a busy man, but I'll take a moment to examine your fanciful picture...

1.0: Hm... Ah. Ahhh, yes! Yes, I remember this one fondly.\r\n#L0##bYou remember now? Are you ready to come clean?#l\n#k
1.1: Come clean? Don't be ridiculous? The Zakum in this picture is a sculpture. I made this for an art class I was in! Ah, those were the good old days. I was a big fan of sculpture and calligraphy, you know. Here, I'll keep this picture, if you don't mind.

yes.0: I can see how my lovely statue could pass for the real thing, but I cannot believe you think I would ACTUALLY have something to do with the REAL Zakum. Now, since you've brought me this little memento, I'll give you a commemorative coin. So, how about dropping this unhealthy curiosity and having some fun, hmmm?
